coverage: Original-world items requiring level 60 or below, retained editorial entries, quests across both continents and special categories, and spawned or quest-linked NPCs. Development placeholders are excluded. Recipe entries are recipe items, not a complete learned-spell database. NPC and object loot links include direct loot rows only. Additional categories cover interactive world objects and selected trained, starting, recipe-linked and item-creation spells. Every record supports its own public discussion.
